data.plainLyric:
My heart, it has been broken by who I cannot tell
By what I loved and what I lost, and what I did as well
Leaving you was easy, well, it wouldn't mean a thing
If you want to know what life's about, you have to feel the sting

On the lonely night, the tears you cannot fight
Howling through the morning, even though you know you're right
Well, they say the world is changing, and that might well be true
But the sun will never settle on the love I have for you
The sun will never settle on the love I have for you

Now when the worst is over, and all is said and done
And both of us are living in the future that we want
A hundred thousand years or more could easily pass me by
But the pain will still be painted on the cruel Britannia skies

And on the lonely night, the tears you cannot fight
Howling through the morning, even though you know you're right
Well, they say the world is changing and that might well be true
But the sun will never settle on the love I have for you
The sun will never settle on the love I have for you

And on the lonely night, the tears you cannot fight
Howling through the morning, even though you know you're right
Well, they say the world is changin' and that might well be true
The sun will never settle on the love I have for you
The sun will never settle on the love I have for you

Oh, the sun will never settle on the love I have for you
The sun will never settle on the love I have for you
